name: building-backend-services
title_zh: 从需求到落地的后端服务全流程施工队长
tagline_zh: 数据模型、架构选型、分阶段实现一次理清；设计文档互相打架时它会先叫停，等你对齐了再动工。
tagline_en: Turns vague asks into data models, architecture, and build phases; halts if design docs conflict, so you align.
desc_en: Use when building a backend service or system end-to-end from requirements — coordinating the full flow of data design, architecture design, stack selection, and implementation as phases, resuming a partially designed service, or checking that existing design documents are consistent with each other before implementation starts.
why_zh: 不是生成代码片段，而是把需求拆成可续接的阶段，中途停下也能从断点接着干，文档一致性检查内置在开工前。
why_en: Resumable phases, not one-shot codegen. It checks doc consistency before starting, so you never build on contradictory specs.
limit_zh: 只认需求描述和设计文档，不接已有代码库的增量改造；不生成部署脚本，产物止步于实现方案与代码骨架。
limit_en: Only for greenfield from specs; no legacy refactoring, no deployment scripts. Output ends at code skeleton and plan.
title_en: End-to-end backend builder from requirements to phased.
